messages.全味方に怠惰の強化と保護を2ターン配りつつ、自分も強化して撃つ、怠惰貫通の広域E: A multi-target Sloth Pierce E.G.O that strengthens its own attack while granting Sloth buffs and Protection to all allies for 2 turns.
messages.全味方へのバフ: 攻撃前に、このターンと次のターンの間、全味方へ怠惰威力増加1、: **Teamwide buffs**: Before attacking, grants all allies 1 Sloth Power Up, 1 Sloth Damage Up, and 2 Protection for this turn and next turn. At Threadspin Ⅲ, Sloth Damage Up rises to 2 and Protection to 3.
messages.精神力の回復: 解析Ⅲから、表面的中時に自分の精神力を15回復する。: **SP recovery**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, a Heads Hit restores 15 SP to the user.
messages.侵蝕スキル: バフは自分だけに付き、的中時に怠惰脆弱と貫通脆弱を2ターン付与する: **Corrosion**: Grants only the Sloth Power Up and Sloth Damage Up buffs to the user; it does not grant Protection. On hit, inflicts 1 Sloth Fragility and 1 Pierce Fragility for 2 turns, increased to 2 each at Threadspin Ⅲ. Targets randomly and cannot distinguish friend from foe.
messages.パッシブ「雨上がりの陽射し」: ターン開始時に全味方の精神力を3回復する。使用後: **Passive — Ray of Sun After Rain**: Restores 3 SP to all allies at Turn Start, beginning on the turn after use.
messages.怠惰属性のスキルが強化されるので、怠惰のスキルを持つ味方が多いほど活きる。: Its buffs strengthen Sloth skills, so teams with more Sloth attacks benefit more.
messages.精神消耗は覚醒35・侵蝕35・OC53と重い。表面が出て回復できる解析Ⅲ以降で使: SP cost is high: 35 Awakening, 35 Corrosion, 53 Overclock. Prefer Threadspin Ⅲ or higher, where a Heads Hit can restore SP.
messages.必要資源は怠惰4・暴食2・憂鬱2・傲慢2。: Costs 4 Sloth, 2 Gluttony, 2 Gloom, and 2 Pride.
messages.Ⅱ: 「雨上がりの陽射し」の解放のみ。: **Ⅱ**: Only unlocks Ray of Sun After Rain.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力とバフ量が上がり、覚醒スキルに精神力回復が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Improves Power and buffs, and adds SP recovery to Awakening.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力が+10から+15、攻撃加重値が5から7になる。強化幅が大きく、: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power rises from +10 to +15, and Attack Weight from 5 to 7. This is a substantial upgrade and a worthwhile target if using the E.G.O.
messages.開花E.G.O::壇香梅: パッシブ「満開」が2名以上を攻撃するときのダメージ量: **[Effloresced E.G.O::Spicebush](persona:0104)**: Full Bloom grants +30% damage when attacking at least 2 targets, fitting this multi-target E.G.O. Sloth S2 and defense help supply its resources.
messages.南部ディエーチ協会4課: S3と守備が怠惰で、必要資源の怠惰を出せる。: **[Dieci Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0108)**: Sloth S3 and defense supply the Sloth resource requirement.
